venture.meaning: a risky or daring business undertaking

versus.meaning: Used to indicate opposition or contrast between two things or people. Against, or in comparison with.

vessel.meaning: A ship or large boat. Also, a hollow container for holding liquid, or a tube in the body that carries blood.

veteran.meaning: A person who has had long experience in a particular field. Someone who has served in the military, especially during a war.

via.meaning: Going through a particular place, method, or person. It means by way of or using something.

victim.meaning: A person who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event.

victory.meaning: Success in a battle, competition, or any difficult situation. It is the state of having won.

view.meaning: A particular way of considering something; an opinion.

village.meaning: a small settlement in the countryside, smaller than a town

violence.meaning: Behavior that involves physical force intended to hurt or kill someone. It involves aggressive and harmful actions.

violent.meaning: Using or involving physical force intended to hurt, injure, or kill someone. Very strong or intense.

visible.meaning: Able to be seen. Noticeable or apparent to the eye.

vision.meaning: A long-term aspirational description of what an organization wants to become.

visitor.meaning: a person who visits a place or person

vital.meaning: absolutely necessary for life or success

voice.meaning: The sound produced in a person's throat and used for speaking or singing.

volume.meaning: The amount of space that a substance or object occupies. It also refers to the loudness of sound.

voluntary.meaning: Done or given by free choice, without being forced or paid. Based on personal willingness.

wage.meaning: payment for work, usually calculated by the hour or day

wall.meaning: a vertical structure that encloses a space

wander.meaning: to walk around slowly without a clear direction or purpose

want.meaning: to wish to have or do something

war.meaning: A period of armed fighting between countries or groups of people.

warn.meaning: to inform someone of possible danger

waste.meaning: Material that is not wanted; the act of using something carelessly.

wave.meaning: A disturbance that travels through a medium; a sudden increase.

way.meaning: a method or manner of doing something

weak.meaning: Not having much physical strength or power; easily damaged or broken; not effective.

weakness.meaning: The state of being weak; a disadvantage or fault.

wealth.meaning: a large amount of money, property, or possessions

wealthy.meaning: Having a large amount of money, property, or valuable possessions; very rich.

weapon.meaning: A tool or object designed or used to cause physical harm or death to people.

weather.meaning: the condition of the air at a place and time

web.meaning: A system of connected websites and pages on the internet (the World Wide Web); a spider's net.

weigh.meaning: To measure how heavy something or someone is. Also means to carefully consider something before making a decision.

weight.meaning: How heavy something or someone is; the force with which something is pulled down by gravity.

weird.meaning: Strange or unusual in an unsettling or surprising way. Not normal or expected.

welcome.meaning: used to greet someone arriving somewhere

welfare.meaning: The health, happiness, and general well-being of a person or group. Government support given to people in need.

well.meaning: in a good or satisfactory way

western.meaning: Relating to or coming from the west, especially the western part of the world or a country.

whatever.meaning: Used to refer to anything or everything of a particular type, regardless of what it is.

wheel.meaning: A circular object that turns around a central point, used on vehicles to allow movement.

when.meaning: at what time; at the time that

whenever.meaning: At any time that; every time that something happens.

where.meaning: in, at, or to what place

whereas.meaning: Used to compare two very different things or situations, showing contrast. It means 'but in comparison'.

whether.meaning: Used to introduce a question or choice between two or more possibilities.

which.meaning: asking for or referring to one out of a set

whilst.meaning: During the time that something is happening; at the same time as. Also used to introduce a contrasting statement.

whisper.meaning: To speak very softly so only a person nearby can hear. You use almost no voice when whispering.

who.meaning: asking about or referring to a person

whole.meaning: Complete or entire; including all parts with nothing missing.

wide.meaning: Having a large distance from one side to the other; broad or extensive.

widely.meaning: Over a large area or range; by many people.

will.meaning: used before a verb to talk about the future
will.translation: verbo modal usado para hablar del futuro

win.meaning: to be successful in a competition

window.meaning: an opening in a wall to let in light and air

wine.meaning: alcoholic drink made from fermented grapes

wing.meaning: the part of a bird for flying

winner.meaning: A person or team that wins a game, competition, or prize.

winter.meaning: the coldest season of the year

wipe.meaning: To clean or dry something by rubbing it with a cloth or other material. To remove something by rubbing.

wire.meaning: A thin, flexible thread or rod made of metal. It is used to carry electricity or to connect things.

wise.meaning: Having or showing good judgment and knowledge, especially gained through experience.

wish.meaning: To want something to be true or to happen, especially something that is difficult or impossible.

withdraw.meaning: to take money out of a bank account

within.meaning: Inside or not further than a particular area, space, or time period.

witness.meaning: A person who sees an event, especially a crime or accident, and can give a first-hand account of it.

wonder.meaning: To think about something with curiosity or doubt; to want to know or understand something.

wood.meaning: The hard material that forms the trunk and branches of trees, used for building and making things.

word.meaning: A single unit of language that has meaning.

worker.meaning: A person who does a job, especially physical or manual work.

world.meaning: the earth and all people in it

worth.meaning: having a value of a specified amount

would.meaning: Used to talk about imagined situations, polite requests, or past habits.

wound.meaning: injury to the body where the skin is cut or broken

wrap.meaning: to cover something in paper or cloth

writer.meaning: A person who writes books, stories, or articles as a job.

wrong.meaning: Not correct or not true; not the right one.

yard.meaning: a piece of land next to a house, used as a garden

yeah.meaning: An informal way of saying yes.

yet.meaning: until now or up to this time

yield.meaning: the income earned from an investment, expressed as a percentage

you.meaning: The person or people being spoken to.

yourself.meaning: Used to refer back to the person being spoken to.

youth.meaning: period of being young; young people

zone.meaning: A specific area that is set apart from others for a particular purpose or has a particular characteristic.
